title: Battle of Vilcapugio
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Vilcapugio", at revision 1377899738, opens: "The Battle of Vilcapugio was a major battle fought on October 1, 1813, during the second Campaign of Upper Peru in the Argentine War of Independence, where the United Provinces forces led by General Manuel Belgrano were defeated by a royalist army, led by Joaquin de la Pezuela." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872673, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1813 battle fought in the Argentine War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
